messages:
sam: Heads-up: onboarding sample app is failing non-deterministically when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and RW_API_KEY are set. CLI picks one, SDK picks the other. Very confusing for new users.

yuki: ugh. do we have a documented precedence? i thought we standardized on REDWOOD_API_KEY first then RW_* fallbacks.

michelle: We did discuss that but never landed it in the CLI. CLI currently reads env in this order: RW_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY -> token file. SDK does REDWOOD_API_KEY -> RW_API_KEY.

sam: yep that's the bug. New hires hit this in the sampleapp tutorial. They get 403s because org/project scoping is applied to one key format and not the other.

michelle: can we add a quick runtime warning in the CLI + cred-checker? something like: `Ambiguous API keys found: RW_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY. Using REDWOOD_API_KEY by default. Remove the other to avoid surprises.`

yuki: i like that. also add a suggestion to run `redwood cred-sanity` which prints what key will be used and resolved org/project.

dev-bot: Reminder: deploy to `dev` env at 1725500200 succeeded :white_check_mark:

sam: prototype of `cred-sanity` output:

```
$ redwood cred-sanity
Found env vars: RW_API_KEY present, REDWOOD_API_KEY present
Resolved key: REDWOOD_API_KEY (explicit precedence)
Resolved org: org_12345 (from provider: org-scoping)
Resolved project: project-website
Warnings:\n - Both RW_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY set. This can cause SDK/CLI mismatch.\n - REDWOOD_API_KEY token is expiring in 2d. Rotate soon with `redwood keys rotate`\n```

michelle: love the UX. also we should include a simple rotation helper command that does: `redwood keys rotate --service sampleapp` that rotates and updates a local `.env.local` for the sample app. makes demos smoother.

yuki: small note on rotation: rotation flow should preserve org/project scoping when the token backend supports it (so clients don't lose access during rollouts). suggest: issue new token with same scopes, do dual-write, then switch env var.

sam: agreed. would be nice to add a fallback policy header in SDK logs so users see when a different key variant was used: `X-Redwood-Cred-Fallback: RW_API_KEY -> REDWOOD_API_KEY`.

michelle: can someone file a tiny RFC? i'll pair on PR for CLI warning + cred-sanity tool. want it in this sprint (sprint 12).

sam: i'll do the RFC draft, tagging @yuki for precedence decision.

yuki: precedence: make REDWOOD_API_KEY canonical (SDK & CLI) and deprecate RW_API_KEY in docs but keep as fallback for one quarter. add telemetry events when fallback occurs.

michelle: ok that's product + devex plan. cc @dev-bot to kick off workspace checklist when PR lands. :rocket:

dev-bot: Checklist created: "cred-sanity + CLI precedence warning" assigned to michelle, sam, yuki. Due: 1725596400

sam: thanks. i'll include a sample `.env.local` patcher in the PR to reduce onboarding friction for the sample app.
